notes.title: The Dreamworld
notes.content:
- The Dreamworld -
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41665588/b5fc5f2649a4f28282a07ea76529fcac16de09d0.png[/img]
A new demon who goes by the name "The Nightmare Lord" has trapped all living things in a dreamworld and is trying to absorb their dreams to become more powerful.
Cloudy and her companions have decided to set off to find this demon before he can achieve this.

The dreamworld is a place where the dreams of all living things come to finally reside. Who knows what kinds of unimaginable and strange things can be found here!
There are also new companions and enemies to meet!

- New Content -
12 New Companions!
50 New Skills!
27 New Artifacts!

A Bunch of New Maps!
A Ton of New Interactive Events!
Loads of Strange New Enemies

- Dream Skills -
Spend Recharges to trigger a super powerful Dream Skill!
There are 12 Dream Skills in total!

- Upgrade -
You can now permanently upgrade your team members!

- Runes -
Runes can be used to upgrade your team's fighting abilities during adventures!

- Hidden Content -
On the map, you may find...
Will your team be able to reach their final evolutions while they're in the dreamworld!?

notes.title: 2022-05-08 更新说明
notes.content:
提高了2层后的敌人血量
提高了梦魇之主的血量

修复了从梦界篇返回标题后开始游戏会进入梦界篇，导致存档被覆盖的bug

如果有玩家不幸触发了此bug，请尝试在地图中间上方（原本传送门的位置）点击进入探索地图，然后点右下角放弃探索返回营地，这样应该可以正常回到梦界篇
而最好的做法是删除梦界篇存档，从新开始，非常抱歉！
梦界篇存档的位置：
window：  %LOCALAPPDATA%/Blackcat
OSX：  ~/Library/Application Support/Blackcat/Default
save文件夹中file1.rpgsave为故事篇存档，file2.rpgsave为梦界篇存档

notes.title: 更新梦界篇
notes.content: The update of Roguelike mode is completed, and we are translating it into English. It will come soon!

notes.title: information of the upcoming update
notes.content:
We are currently working on updating the game, including new story, new system, now characters, and new enemies!
It will be released soon!_(:3J∠)_

notes.title: 2022-02-10 Update description
notes.content:
Before the little green joined, the probability of encountering a special event of getting lost increased
Added team novice guide and battle novice guide
Gem and scroll prices rise
You can buy multiple props at one time!

Fixed the bug that the skill will still work after Little Green and Fluffy are knocked down

The pollution effect is changed to trigger at the end of the turn
Cotton basic HP + 1

Modified the effect of the following skills:
Cotton - Purify
Sakura - Throwing Knife
Red-eye - Vengeance

notes.title: 2020-01-25 Updated instructions
notes.content:
Fixed a BUG where Church Quest could not be completed due to skipping the beginning of the story.

If you save after triggering a BUG, you can inherit the save after a defeat and restore it to normal.

notes.title: 2022-01-24 Updated instructions
notes.content:
Fixed a bug where the Quick Gloves of the Artifact did not increase the item cap to 3
Added a novice boot that tells you how to view the main task content
Added the option to skip the opening story after inheriting the archive
And a few minor changes

There was no announcement of the update so maybe some players didn't know, so here's a mention:
There is now an automatic saving function, while sleeping will automatically save  _(:3J∠)_
